tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Сообщение владельцу в Telegram (CP5, CP10): тревога «работа стоит» и ежедневный отчёт. Только отправка, только stdlib.

    notify.py [--project <путь>] send "текст"     # одно сообщение владельцу
    notify.py [--project <путь>] test             # проверка связи: «связь есть»

Бот и чат — переменные окружения `RPV_TG_TOKEN` (токен бота от @BotFather) и `RPV_TG_CHAT` (чат владельца); в репозитории
их нет. Не заданы — отправки нет, строка в `<проект>/.claude/dispatcher/notify.log`. Сбой сети — повтор, потом строка в
лог; исключений наружу нет: тревога не должна ронять диспетчер.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import project as P  # noqa: E402

API = "https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendMessage"
TRIES = 3
TIMEOUT_S = 15.0
LIMIT = 4000  # знаков в сообщении (у Telegram 4096)


def configured() -> bool:
    return bool(P.env("TG_TOKEN") and P.env("TG_CHAT"))


def _log(project, line: str, log_dir=None) -> None:
    if not (project or log_dir):
        return
    try:
        d = Path(log_dir) if log_dir else Path(project) / ".claude" / "dispatcher"
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with (d / "notify.log").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"{P.now_iso()}\t{line}\n")
    except OSError:
        pass


def send(text: str, project=None, opener=urllib.request.urlopen, sleep=time.sleep, log_dir=None) -> bool:
    """True — Telegram принял сообщение. Не настроено, пустой текст, сбой — False и строка в notify.log (каталог
    состояния проекта или `log_dir`)."""
    text = (text or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return False
    if not configured():
        _log(project, f"не отправлено (нет RPV_TG_TOKEN/RPV_TG_CHAT): {text[:120]}", log_dir)
        return False
    body = json.dumps({"chat_id": P.env("TG_CHAT"), "text": text[:LIMIT]}, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(API.format(token=P.env("TG_TOKEN")), data=body,
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8"})
    err = ""
    for i in range(TRIES):
        try:
            with opener(req, timeout=TIMEOUT_S) as r:
                if json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8")).get("ok"):
                    _log(project, f"отправлено: {text[:120]}", log_dir)
                    return True
                err = "ответ без ok"
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:  # 4xx — токен/чат неверны: повтор не поможет
            err = f"HTTP {e.code}"
            if 400 <= e.code < 500:
                break
        except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
            err = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        if i + 1 < TRIES:
            sleep(2 * (i + 1))
    _log(project, f"не отправлено ({err}): {text[:120]}", log_dir)
    return False


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    P.utf8_stdio()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="notify.py", description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--project", default=None)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    s = sub.add_parser("send")
    s.add_argument("text")
    sub.add_parser("test")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        project = Path(a.project).resolve() if a.project else P.resolve_project([])
    except P.ProjectNotFound:
        project = None
    if not configured():
        print("Telegram не настроен: задайте RPV_TG_TOKEN и RPV_TG_CHAT", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    ok = send(a.text if a.cmd == "send" else "Связь есть: сюда придут отчёт и тревога «работа стоит».", project)
    print("отправлено" if ok else "не отправлено — причина в .claude/dispatcher/notify.log")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import errors as E  # noqa: E402
import haiku_aux as HA  # noqa: E402
import overseer as O  # noqa: E402
import project as P  # noqa: E402
import registry as R  # noqa: E402
import ticket as T  # noqa: E402

TEXT = "---\nid: X-1\n\ntitle: заголовок: с двоеточием\nstatus: open\n---\nописание\n\n## Лог\n\n### 2026-10-27T07:00:00+04:00 ceo\nзапись\n"


class FrontmatterTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parse_lf_crlf_blank_lines_and_no_header(self):
        want = {"id": "X-1", "title": "заголовок: с двоеточием", "status": "open"}
        self.assertEqual(P.frontmatter(TEXT)[0], want)
        self.assertEqual(TEXT[P.frontmatter(TEXT)[1]:].split("\n")[0], "описание")
        crlf = TEXT.replace("\n", "\r\n")
        self.assertEqual(P.frontmatter(crlf)[0], want)
        self.assertEqual(crlf[P.frontmatter(crlf)[1]:].split("\r\n")[0], "описание")
        self.assertIsNone(P.frontmatter("просто текст\n---\nid: 1\n---\n"))

    def test_every_reader_gets_the_same_header(self):
        want = P.frontmatter(TEXT)[0]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            f = Path(d) / "X-1.md"
            f.write_text(TEXT, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
            self.assertEqual(T._parse_header(TEXT)[0], want)
            self.assertEqual(E.header(f), want)
            self.assertEqual(R.goal_header(f), want)
            self.assertEqual(O.split_ticket(TEXT)[0], want)
            self.assertEqual(HA.agent_meta(f)[0], want)
            self.assertEqual(T._parse_header(TEXT)[1], P.frontmatter(TEXT)[1])

    def test_no_header_is_what_each_reader_always_said(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            f = Path(d) / "plain.md"
            f.write_text("без шапки\n", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertEqual((E.header(f), R.goal_header(f), O.split_ticket("без шапки\n")[0]), ({}, {}, {}))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                T._parse_header("без шапки\n")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                HA.agent_meta(f)


class SetHeaderLockTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_set_header_waits_for_the_record_lock(self):
        """`_set_header` идёт под замком записи: пока другой поток держит замок, правка не проходит."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            f = Path(d) / "E-1.md"
            f.write_text("---\nid: E-1\nstatus: open\n---\nтело\n", encoding="utf-8")
            held, release, done = threading.Event(), threading.Event(), threading.Event()

            def holder():
                with T.ticket_lock(f):
                    held.set()
                    release.wait(10)

            def writer():
                E._set_header(f, {"status": "fixed"})
                done.set()

            h = threading.Thread(target=holder)
            h.start()
            self.assertTrue(held.wait(10))
            w = threading.Thread(target=writer)
            w.start()
            self.assertFalse(done.wait(0.5), "правка прошла мимо замка")
            self.assertEqual(E.header(f)["status"], "open")
            release.set()
            h.join(10)
            w.join(10)
            self.assertTrue(done.is_set())
            self.assertEqual(E.header(f)["status"], "fixed")
            self.assertTrue(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8").endswith("---\nтело\n"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

RETURN = re.compile(r"^\[итог:\s*return\]")

# --- живая работа ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
OPEN = ("todo", "in_progress", "in_review", "waiting", "blocked", "needs_owner")
SUPPRESS_H = 24            # одна находка по тикету — не чаще раза в сутки (без этого модель повторяет её в каждом окне)
MAX_TICKETS = 12           # тикетов за один взгляд: самые свежие записи и MAX_COSTLY самых дорогих из остальных
MAX_COSTLY = 2             # дорогой дрейфующий тикет не всегда самый свежий
MODEL, EFFORT = "claude-haiku-5-5", "xhigh"  # замер 14.10 (CP14, история проекта): xhigh до половины цены ловит 6 из 10, high — 2
PER_CALL_USD = 0.05        # потолок цены одного вызова (`--max-budget-usd`); замер: средняя $0.0023
TIMEOUT_S = 180
COST_STEPS = (6, 12)       # ступени правила «дорого»: × медиана цены закрытых тикетов проекта
MIN_CLOSED = 5             # меньше закрытых тикетов — масштаба нет, правила «дорого» нет
SPIKE_H, SPIKE_K = 6, 3    # правило «всплеск»: траты тикета за SPIKE_H ч > SPIKE_K × обычных трат тикета за SPIKE_H ч
SPIKE_MIN = 30             # меньше стольких замеров «траты за окно» в истории проекта — правила «всплеск» нет
ACTIVE_H = 24              # тикет без записей и запусков за столько часов — брошен, а не тратит: его не смотрим
STATE_NAME, LOG_NAME = "overseer.json", "overseer.log"
SELF = "надзиратель"       # автор записей Надзирателя в логе тикета
GOAL_ID = re.compile(r"\bG-\d{3,}\b")
ASK = re.compile(r"\[итог:\s*ask-owner\]|needs_owner|владельц\w* вопрос|спрошу владельца|спрашиваю владельца", re.I)


def claude_bin() -> str:
    """`claude` берётся при вызове, не при импорте: в тестах `CLAUDE_BIN` подменён на несуществующий файл (conftest)."""
    return os.environ.get("CLAUDE_BIN") or shutil.which("claude") or "claude"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def parse_ts(s: str) -> datetime:
    return T.parse_time(s, DEFAULT_TZ, strict=True)


def norm_ws(s: str) -> str:
    return " ".join((s or "").split())


@dataclass
class Entry:
    ts: datetime
    role: str
    text: str
    norm: str = field(default="", repr=False)  # текст с нормализованными пробелами — для проверки цитаты

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not self.norm:
            self.norm = norm_ws(self.text)


@dataclass
class Run:
    ts: datetime
    role: str
    cost: float          # начислено запуску (resolved_cost, иначе cost_usd)
    status: str = ""

@dataclass
class Ticket:
    tid: str
    title: str
    status: str
    desc: str
    entries: list


def parse_log(text: str) -> list:
    """Записи лога: `### <ISO> <роль>` и текст до следующего такого заголовка. Что до первого заголовка — не запись."""
    ms = list(HDR.finditer(text))
    out = []
    for i, m in enumerate(ms):
        end = ms[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(ms) else len(text)
        out.append(Entry(parse_ts(m.group(1)), m.group(2), text[m.end():end].strip()))
    return out


def split_ticket(text: str) -> tuple:
    """Файл тикета → (шапка, описание, текст лога). Описание — между шапкой и `## Лог`."""
    fm = P.frontmatter(text)
    head, body = (fm[0], text[fm[1]:]) if fm else ({}, text)
    lg = re.search(r"^## Лог[ \t]*$", body, re.M)
    if not lg:
        return head, body.strip(), ""
    return head, body[:lg.start()].strip(), body[lg.end():]


def merge_entries(*lists) -> list:
    """Записи архива и файла по времени; одинаковые (время, роль, текст) — одна."""
    seen, out = set(), []
    for e in sorted((e for lst in lists for e in lst), key=lambda e: e.ts):
        key = (e.ts, e.role, e.text)
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            out.append(e)
